patch_description: Reorganizes the ansatz into a compact encode–entangle–mix architecture. Graph-related qubits share initial and final RY parameters to regularize training, while independent RZ phases retain local discrimination. The interaction graph is scheduled as disjoint matchings for lower effective depth, with trainable CRZ probes on both high-centrality branches [0,7] and [5,7]. A noncommuting post-entanglement RY layer converts learned phase correlations into measurable amplitudes while using fewer parameters than the previous full two-rotation design.
